prompt: Fill in both blanks so the job runs once per OS-and-Node combination and installs the matching Node version.
explanation: The `matrix:` key sits under `strategy`, and its lists multiply into one job per combination; steps read the current values through the `matrix` context — here `${{ matrix.node }}`. Two OSes times two Node versions means four runs of the same job.
template:
name: Cross-platform CI
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      ___:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        node: [18, 20]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ ___ }}
